job.name: astra_board_tarot
job.meaning: «Таро-гравюра»: золотая линейная гравюра на тёмно-фиолетовом, рамки карт таро
job.prompt: Create a complete design system board (style guide sheet, 16:9) for a series of VERTICAL 9:16 animated humorous Reels for an astrology blog «Астрология без сахара», series «Представь: ты — Скорпион». There is NO presenter: the viewer is the hero — a FACELESS, GENDER-NEUTRAL cartoon character «ты» (no facial features, short neutral hair, loose dark outfit with a small scorpion pin), so anyone can imagine themselves. Episode 1 is a funny day of a Scorpio based on zodiac stereotypes: at 7 am in bed the hero's eyes already scan who will lie today; at the office a colleague sweats under the hero's stare and confesses; at home the partner (another faceless character, different colour) says «Я в пятницу задержусь» and the hero instantly builds a detective board with red threads; at 11 pm, new moon, partner asleep, the hero burns a paper note at the window. Blocks on the board: title «Представь · ты — Скорпион», colour palette with HEX codes, typography, the hero in 3 poses (squinting in bed, crossed arms with intense stare, holding a burning note), the partner in 1 pose, a game-like TOP PANEL «♏ СКОРПИОН · НОВОЛУНИЕ» with meters «ИНТУИЦИЯ 100%» and «ДОВЕРИЕ 3%», a stamp «СЕКРЕТНО», a SUBTITLES style (one key word highlighted), an end card «Напиши свой знак», and a block «КАДРЫ 9:16» with 4 phone-shaped frames: (1) bedroom 07:00 with scanning eyes; (2) office, colleague confessing; (3) detective board at home with the partner; (4) dark new moon window, burning note. In every phone frame keep text away from the top 13% and the bottom 22%. All text in Russian, short, correctly spelled. The attached screenshot is the blog's Instagram profile: take ONLY its colours and typographic mood (deep indigo night sky, gold, lavender, cream, elegant italic serif headlines with small spaced capitals above them); do not copy its posts or photos. Style: TAROT CARD ENGRAVING — fine gold line art, cross-hatching, ornamental art-nouveau card frames around every scene, each scene looks like a funny tarot card with a title at the bottom («СЫЩИК», «ПРИЗНАНИЕ», «НОВОЛУНИЕ»). Palette: deep purple #1E1533 and #2B1F47, antique gold #CFA858, lavender #A796D1, parchment #EFE4CC.
job.person_note: The attached screenshot is only a colour and typography reference of the blog; the hero is a faceless gender-neutral cartoon character, not a real person.
job.style_qa: гравюра в стиле карт таро, золотые линии на тёмно-фиолетовом, с юмором; герой и партнёр нарочно БЕЗ лица и без пола — это не дефект
